# Sharpwise

> Sharpwise is a free maths and English game for children in Reception to Year 6 (ages 4 to 11) in England. A question appears, answers float up in bubbles, and the child slices the right one. Reception topics follow the EYFS Early Learning Goals; Years 1 to 6 follow the National Curriculum for England.

- Free, with no adverts and no tracking. There is no account; progress is saved on the device.
- Plays in any modern web browser on a phone, tablet or computer, and works offline after the first visit.
- Made by Inobil Technology Ltd.
